data.route: frozen pytket JSON -> guppy.load_pytket inside a @guppy main that allocates the qubits, calls it, records result('c', bits) and discards the qubits -> main.compile() (HUGR package) -> selene_sim.build -> run_shots(Quest, IdealErrorModel)
data.what_pass_means: the frozen native circuits survive the Helios Guppy/HUGR route offline and reproduce their exact distributions on Selene; not a Helios device or Helios-1E statement
